eyebrow: Clean CSV for scripts and logging
code:
$ nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used,memory.total \
  --format=csv -l 1
utilization.gpu [%], memory.used [MiB], memory.total [MiB]
97 %, 22104 MiB, 40960 MiB
caption: No box-drawing characters to parse — just structured rows
